title: rondeletia stellata subsp. yumuriensis
intro: Rondeletia stellata subsp. yumuriensis, commonly known as the Yumuri Rondeletia, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimalarial, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Rondeletia stellata subsp. yumuriensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
